# Low hills behind the village: flattened, jittered icospheres along world z -8..-10. Up Z.
new
material new Hill --base-color 0.1216 0.0196 0.0627 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name H0 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -7.5 9 0
scale 2.6 1.6 1.3
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 1
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
delete vert
mode object
material assign Hill
add mesh ico-sphere --name H1 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -3.6 8.6 0
scale 2.4 1.6 1.0
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 2
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
delete vert
mode object
material assign Hill
add mesh ico-sphere --name H2 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 0.4 9.4 0
scale 3.0 1.6 1.5
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 3
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
delete vert
mode object
material assign Hill
add mesh ico-sphere --name H3 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 4.4 8.8 0
scale 2.3 1.6 0.9
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 4
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
delete vert
mode object
material assign Hill
add mesh ico-sphere --name H4 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 7.8 9.2 0
scale 2.8 1.6 1.3
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 5
select vert where "pos.z < -0.05"
delete vert
mode object
material assign Hill
select all
active H0
join
rename H0 Hills
shade flat
export hills.glb
